records.headline: A decade in LatAm has taught us one thing above all else 🌎
records.post_text:
A decade in LatAm has taught us one thing above all else 🌎

Our Head of Business Development, Arcangelo Lonoce, has been at the heart of Habanero's LatAm journey since the very beginning and that experience is ingrained into every slot we release. 

The markets across Latin America are as diverse as the players in them. Habanero has spent years learning those differences and building them into our content strategy:

🎰 Evolving the familiar 
Games rooted in strong mathematics that feel instantly familiar to players with a land-based heritage, perfectly balancing innovation with tradition.

🎰Localised for every market
Habanero's portfolio is built around themes, gameplay dynamics and cultural references that resonate locally.

🎰 Relationships that run deep
Nearly a decade of partnerships with the operators who know these markets better than anyone.

The result is a portfolio that feels native rather than imported, across every market we operate in.

Want to find out what Habanero's games can do for your players? 
📩 sales@habanerosystems.com

records.headline: Years of working across LatAm have shaped the way we think about growth 🌎
records.post_text:
Years of working across LatAm have shaped the way we think about growth 🌎

One thing has become clear: there isn't a single formula for success across the region.

From Brazil and Mexico to Colombia and Peru, every market has its own regulations, player preferences and commercial realities. Understanding those differences is what turns opportunities into long-term growth.

Our Business Development Manager, Milda Mikelioniene, shares some of the key takeaways from our journey across the region:

🎯 Why treating LatAm as one market rarely works
🎯 The country that's exceeded our growth expectations
🎯 The features players continue to engage with across the region
🎯 How Habanero has built a strong presence, market by market

👉 Swipe through to see our perspective!

more_relevant_posts.post_text: Digitain is sharpening its focus on Asia with the appointment of Terry Lee as Head of Asia Region, signalling a clear intent to compete more aggressively across regulated markets in one of the industry’s most complex geographies. With more than 15 years’ iGaming experience in business development, strategic partnerships and commercial growth, Terry will lead regional strategy, partner relationships and market expansion at a time when localisation and regulatory nuance are non negotiable. He describes Digitain’s strength as a mix of adaptability, local fit and a broad product ecosystem, with a remit to build long term partnerships that add real value rather than simply securing distribution. Ani Mkrtchyan , Chief Sales Officer at Digitain, highlights Asia as a strategic growth region and points to Terry’s track record and regional understanding as key to the next phase of expansion. The impact of this hire will be judged on how effectively Digitain can turn that leadership depth into sustainable gains for operators across diverse, tightly regulated Asian markets. Read Malta Media’s full analysis of Digitain’s Asia leadership appointment here: https://lnkd.in/dmAJ44pt

A regional playbook can open doors. But in LATAM, local execution is what closes them. It is easy to look at the region and build one plan: 📌 One sales motion 📌 One partner strategy 📌 One regional message 📌 One expansion target But the market does not move as one block. What works in Brazil may not work in Mexico. What opens a conversation in Colombia may not move it forward in Chile. Different markets bring different buying rhythms, trust signals, payment habits and partner dynamics. That is why a regional strategy is useful. But it only works when execution adapts locally. Opening the door is one thing. Turning that opportunity into revenue is another. How much of your LATAM strategy is regional, and how much is built for how each market actually moves?

At MAPIC, international business is at the heart of every conversation. Our geo-focused conference programme provides valuable insights into the world's most dynamic retail markets, helping you identify where the next growth opportunities lie. From India and the Middle East to Latin America and South Africa, discover the trends shaping each region to support your expansion strategy. Beyond market intelligence, MAPIC connects you with retailers actively seeking cross-border growth and the property players ready to support their ambitions. Whether you're looking to enter new markets, attract international brands, or build long-term partnerships, you'll find the right decision-makers under one roof, making MAPIC the ideal place to forge global connections and unlock new business opportunities. Check the programme, and save the conferences that will support your growth: http://spkl.io/60437zscL

What makes a local team a key part of a global company? Kostas Vasilakis , International Markets Lead and Country Head in Switzerland, takes us closer to the way the affiliate works and what defines the team: 📌 Sharing learnings that can create value beyond the local market. 📌 Maintaining rigour, even in the most demanding moments. 📌 Seeing every achievement as the starting point for the next challenge. Through his experience, we discover how the Swiss team combines market knowledge, commitment and a shared vision with the wider company. Because global work is also built on the perspective, experience and way of working of every team. #InspiredByTheSea

One of the biggest opportunities in LATAM isn't entering another market. It's learning from the ones you're already in. Brazil, Argentina and the wider Latin American region each have their own player behaviours, payment preferences, regulations and commercial landscapes. But every market also teaches valuable lessons that can strengthen the next expansion. The operators that grow successfully across LATAM aren't simply replicating the same strategy everywhere. They're adapting locally while building a consistent regional vision. The more we share knowledge across markets, the stronger the entire ecosystem becomes. Growth isn't just about moving into new countries. It's about understanding them. What's the biggest lesson you've learned from working in different LATAM markets? #LATAM #Brazil #Argentina #iGaming #BusinessDevelopment #GrowthStrategy #Partnerships #MarketExpansion

🌎 An established presence across Latin America. Since opening our first subsidiary in Brazil in 2010, we've continued to strengthen our presence across Latin America, bringing our team closer to customers throughout the region. For us, proximity means more than geography. It means understanding local markets, providing more agile support and building long-term relationships based on trust and collaboration. Combined with our global sourcing network, our regional presence helps us connect customers across Latin America with high-quality ingredients and the technical expertise that supports them. #VidaraFF #global #LatAm

𝐺𝑙𝑜𝑏𝑎𝑙 𝑒𝑥𝑝𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑖𝑠𝑛'𝑡 𝑎 𝑠𝑖𝑛𝑔𝑙𝑒 𝑑𝑒𝑐𝑖𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛. 𝐼𝑡'𝑠 𝑎 𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑐𝑒𝑠𝑠. Many founders think entering Europe starts with pitching customers. It doesn't. It starts with understanding the market, validating your assumptions, refining your strategy, and building the right connections. That's exactly what happens inside Discover Sweden. 𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝟏𝟎𝟎 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬, 𝐲𝐨𝐮'𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐒𝐰𝐞𝐝𝐞𝐧-𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐨: - Validate your market opportunity - Build your Nordic go-to-market strategy - Refine your ICP and positioning - Connect with the right ecosystem - Create an actionable expansion roadmap Every week is designed to move you one step closer from preparation to market readiness. If Sweden or the Nordic region is part of your global growth plans, this program is built for you. We're looking forward to joining the Chamber of Commerce of Metropolitan Montreal for an engaging discussion on the opportunities and considerations for manufacturers expanding into Mexico. Collectron's leadership will share practical insights on market entry strategies, operating models, and key considerations for establishing manufacturing operations in Mexico. We look forward to connecting with Canadian manufacturers exploring growth opportunities across North America.

When international companies enter a new market, success depends on more than incorporation paperwork. They need customers. They need trusted introductions. They need local partnerships. They need people who understand the Canadian business landscape. That's exactly why Roseview created its new Market Entry Program. Our team works alongside international businesses to establish Canadian operations while helping them build meaningful relationships that accelerate growth. Younea is one example of how we're helping innovative companies successfully launch and scale in Canada.

We've built Fontakt around local expertise and we are excited to introduce Antanas Leonas Česnulis , our local Country Partner in Lithuania. 🇱🇹 Antanas helps companies grow their sales in Lithuania by finding the right prospects, reaching decision-makers and creating new sales opportunities in the local market. Antanas shares: "As the Baltic region continues to grow, more international businesses are entering local markets. But entering a market is not the same as connecting with it. Successful outreach requires local knowledge, trusted relationships, and communication in the local language. Our broad partner network brings all three together, helping your business connect locally and grow internationally." With a background in international business and sales, Antanas understands how to build sales opportunities and connect businesses with the right decision-makers. He also supports Lithuanian companies with their export growth by helping them reach new customers across the Baltics and Nordics. Whether you are looking to increase sales in Lithuania or expand internationally, our local teams are here to help you find new customers and grow.
